newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA TO STAR IN TELEVISION MOVIES.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA TO STAR IN TELEVISION MOVIES.

text.p: Alpine skiing star Alberto Tomba said on Tuesday he had signed a contract to play the hero in two Italian television movies to be shot next year.

"I'm happy and at the same time curious about throwing myself into this new adventure," Tomba said after Cecchi Gori Communications, which owns Italy's private TeleMonteCarlo channel, announced the deal.
The former Olympic and world champion was in Rome watching the Italian Open tennis tournament.
Cecchi Gori said shooting would start in April 1998, after the Nagano Winter Olympics.
"It will be two action films of an hour and a half each, which will be televised in Autumn 1998."
Cecchi Gori said the films would be filmed in English to allow their sale and broadcast internationally.
Tomba has said in the past he wanted to be involved in movies and had been linked to an American serial.

"With this exclusive deal we have guaranteed a personality who is already a star in his field and has what it takes to become number one in the world of showbusiness," said Francesco Nespega, director general of the Cecchi Gori Group.
